 Judgment

The present appeal is filed by the appellants/claimants challenging the judgment and award dated 09.02.2018 in MVC.No.1085/2015 passed by the Senior civil Judge and MACT VI at Kudligi for seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The factum of accident, death of the deceased and coverage of insurance is not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.
The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.3,75,000/- only and it is not adequate.

Therefore,
the same is to be enhanced.
The deceased was a minor girl who was aged about 7 years at the time of accident, as found from the records and discussed by the Tribunal in the judgment.

Therefore, the compensation should be awarded by following the principles of law laid down by the NC:
2023:KHC-D:10538 Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of KISHAN GOPAL VS. LALA AND OTHERS reported in (2014)1 SCC 244.

entities.text: KISHAN GOPAL VS. LALA AND OTHERS reported in (2014)1 SCC 244
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Since the deceased was a minor girl, aged about 7 years old ,
the notional income is to be taken at Rs.30,000/- per annum and further taking multiplier according to young age of the parents, namely the mother, who was aged about 28 years, at the time of accident, the appropriate multiplier applicable is '17'.

Therefore, the compensation under the head loss of dependency including loss of future prospects in life is hereby awarded as follows:
Rs.30,000/- p.a., x 17 = Rs.5,10,000/- Accordingly, compensation of Rs.5,10,000/- is awarded under the head loss of dependency including loss of future prospects in life.

5. Further compensation of Rs.50,000/- is awarded under the head other conventional heads such as loss of consortium including loss of love and affection, funeral expenses, transportation of dead body and obsequies.

Thus, in all, the appellants/claimants are entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
1 Loss of dependency including Rs. 5,10,000/-
loss of future prospects in life 2

Conventional heads such as Rs.
loss of consortium including loss of love and affection, 50,000/-
 funeral expenses,

3  and obsequies

sentences.text: The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.3,75,000/-, but the appellants/claimants are entitled for total compensation of Rs.5,60,000/-.

Therefore, the appellants/claimants are entitled for total compensation of Rs.5,60,000/- as against Rs.3,75,000/- awarded by the Tribunal, along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a., from the date of petition till realization.
8. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following NC: 2023:KHC-D:10538 ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 09.02.2018 passed in MVC.No.1085/2015 passed by the Senior Civil Judge and MACT VI at Kudligi is hereby modified to the extent that the appellants/claimants are entitled to total compensation of Rs.5,60,000/- as against Rs.3,75,000/-
awarded by the Tribunal, along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a., from the date of petition till realization.
iii. No order as to costs.
iv. The appellants/claimants are not entitled to interest for the delay period of 665 days in filing the appeal.
v. Draw award accordingly.

SD/-
 JUDGE HMB Sri.
